OLab has always been founded on Directed Graphs. This is the mechanism by which Nodes and Links are described and interact with each other. Directed Graph Markup Language (DGML) provides a standard descriptive language to describe our graphs, which can then be used to allow for analysis using other graph analytic tools and graph networks.
dct_title_s: Direct Graph Markup Language and OLab directed acyclic graphs (DAGs)
